title: Agency data quality rubric
description: Criteria-driven review of a state DOT's work-zone data practice, computed from its own published feed. Every criterion names the record fields that ground it; the verification agent recomputes each score and refuses ungrounded claims.

criteria.question: What fraction of work-zone records carry verified start AND end dates?
What fraction of records declare a recognized vehicle_impact value?
What fraction of records include usable geometry?
What fraction of records carry a substantive free-text description (>= 40 characters)?
What fraction of records allow a non-negative duration to be derived from their dates?
